A.name: Image-led
A.principle: The person's photo is the page. Edge to edge, square corners at the screen edge, words over a smooth scrim, one big number when there is no photo.

B.name: Calm and spacious
B.principle: Words before imagery, nothing on top of a photo, no filled headers, compact identity. Sheets keep you where you were.

C.name: Social and expressive
C.principle: What connects two people leads, on solid purple. Warm headings, starters for the blank field, collected day marks.

exclusive.why: Both replace the same Streak header; the V7 choice would hide the V6 one.
Both set how the Discover photo is laid out.
Edge to edge has no page margin to choose.

v7-compliment.title: Compliment journey, four arrangements
v7-compliment.note: Same person, same credits. Entry, main, written, leaving with a draft, failed send, completion, back on Discover, and a person who cannot be sent one.

direction.title: Each direction across four screens
direction.note: Same data and viewport. A direction applies to all four or none, so screens do not contradict each other.

v7-discover.task: Decide quickly and fairly whether this person is interesting.
v7-discover.problem: The inset photo is a card among cards: in the render the photo, the prompt and About me carry similar weight, though the photo drives the first impression.
v7-discover.essential: Now: face, name, age, job, the action to compliment, safety menu. Later: prompts, About me, further photos (one scroll away).
v7-discover.primary: Swipe to decide, or compliment the photo. Completion is the next person appearing.
v7-discover.benefit: A: larger face at the moment of decision. B: identity read before looks. C: a reason to start talking.
v7-discover.cost: A: name sits on the image and depends on the scrim. B: square photo shows less. C: banner adds height and only appears when something is shared.
v7-discover.hypothesis: If the photo reaches the edges, members look at more of the face before deciding; a real test would compare time to first decision and Compliment rate.
references: Hinge profile, prompt card with anchored action: https://mobbin.com/screens/935ec54d-ecb9-4760-83ff-9d762406f786
Ente Updated screens page 12099:96447 (20 margin, surfaces)
v7-discover.route: /home, discover_screen.dart with EdgeBleed and PersonHeroCard layouts F and N
v7-discover.verification: Rendered on Pixel_10 with a bright and a busy photo; compliment and overflow actions tapped in the journey run.

critique.product: A fits the task best; C is honest because it uses real shared interests and disappears when there are none.
critique.visual: A is the strongest image; B feels like a different, quieter product; disagreement remains on whether B undersells photos.
critique.interaction: Safety menu and Compliment keep their place and 44pt targets in all three.
critique.engineering: EdgeBleed is one small render box; no duplicated screen tree.

tradeoffs.A: Overlay text relies on the scrim on bright photos.
tradeoffs.C: Extra banner height pushes the prompt down.

v7-compliment.task: Say something specific about one photo or prompt.
v7-compliment.problem: On the baseline the thing being complimented is a small thumbnail, and leaving the profile for a page breaks the connection between what you saw and what you write.
v7-compliment.essential: Now: the exact photo or prompt, the field, the cost and rule. Later: nothing.
v7-compliment.primary: Send. Completion is a clear sent state, then Discover moves on. No credit is used unless the send is accepted.
v7-compliment.benefit: A: you write looking at the photo. B: you stay on the profile. C: starters help with the blank field.
v7-compliment.cost: A: the large photo pushes the field down, and the keyboard covers it while typing. B: less room at large text. C: starters risk generic messages, so they only fill the field and are edited before sending.
v7-compliment.hypothesis: If context stays visible more Compliments mention something specific; measure by review of sent text in a consented study, not by volume.
references: Hinge action anchored on the prompt: https://mobbin.com/screens/935ec54d-ecb9-4760-83ff-9d762406f786
v7-compliment.route: /compliment/:id or a sheet from openCompliment, compliment_screens.dart
v7-compliment.verification: Whole journey run for each arrangement: entry, write, discard choice, failed send keeping the words, sent, blocked person.

critique.product: Credit debit, one-per-pair and reply-first rules are untouched in all arrangements.
critique.visual: A is the most persuasive; C's title is warm but its chips are visually small.
critique.interaction: B's sheet shares the discard choice and back behaviour with the page.
critique.engineering: One composer with an embedded flag; no second implementation.

tradeoffs.A: Field is lower on the screen.
tradeoffs.B: Tight with large text and the keyboard.

v7-profile.task: Check how I appear and find what needs doing.
v7-profile.problem: The photo card takes the top half before setup, streak or credits appear, and they sit below the fold.
v7-profile.essential: Now: how others see me, setup progress. Later: lists of settings.
v7-profile.benefit: A: same feeling as Discover, so you see yourself as others do. B: nearly everything is visible at once. C: streak and credits are one tap away.
v7-profile.cost: A pushes lists further down. B loses the sense of seeing your photo. C repeats what Your activity lists below.
v7-profile.hypothesis: If Profile matches the Discover presentation members better understand their own card.
v7-profile.verification: Rendered; edit and strip targets exercised by route tests.

critique.product: B serves maintenance best, A serves self-image best.
critique.visual: Square corners were needed on A after the first render showed rounded corners at the screen edge.
critique.interaction: Each half of C's strip is a separate 44pt target with its own label.

v7-streak.task: See where I am and what counts today.
v7-streak.problem: The white card with a flame looks like every other card, so progress has little presence.
v7-streak.essential: Now: current run, day in the cycle, whether today counts. Later: how a day counts, repair offer.
v7-streak.primary: Understand progress; repair is offered only when eligible.
v7-streak.benefit: A: one number reads instantly. B: quiet. C: collected marks feel rewarding without adding any new reward.
v7-streak.cost: A loses today's status text. C's purple header competes with Repair.
v7-streak.hypothesis: If progress reads at a glance members can answer what is left today without reading.
v7-streak.verification: Rendered with a repair offer visible; awards and repair logic not touched.

critique.product: A omits 'Today counts'; C keeps the cycle but not today's state, which is a known gap in both.
critique.interaction: Day marks are not interactive; state uses a tick as well as colour.
critique.engineering: Inline in the screen; extract if selected.

v7-likes-locked.task: Understand that people like me and what my options are.
v7-likes-locked.problem: Two blank locked tiles look like images that failed to load.
v7-likes-locked.essential: Now: how many, how to see them, that Discover is a free route.
v7-likes-locked.primary: See who with Premium, or go to Home.
v7-likes-locked.benefit: Honest and clear, no empty frames.
v7-likes-locked.cost: Less sense of real people waiting.
v7-likes-locked.hypothesis: A plain count avoids a broken-looking state with no pressure added.
v7-likes-locked.verification: Rendered; first render repeated the number, corrected to say it once.

critique.product: No urgency or blur tricks added.
critique.visual: Lots of space below; acceptable for a single message.

v7-request.task: Read what someone said and decide whether to reply.
v7-request.problem: Their words have the same weight as the context under them.
v7-request.essential: Now: their words, what they were about, who sent it. Later: their full profile.
v7-request.primary: Reply, which is free and opens the chat.
v7-request.benefit: A: the words land. B: you meet the person first.
v7-request.cost: A: the sender is quieter. B: the photo can steer the decision before the words are read.
v7-request.hypothesis: Words-first encourages replies to what was said.
v7-request.verification: Rendered; first render of B pushed the actions below the fold, corrected to a 4:3 photo.

critique.product: Dismiss and report stay available in all.

v7-nav.problem: Icon-only tabs rely on recognition; four tabs have room for names.
v7-nav.essential: Where I am, and where I can go.
v7-nav.benefit: Named destinations are clearer for new members.
v7-nav.cost: Takes more height and loses content running beneath the bar.
v7-nav.hypothesis: Labels help mainly in the first sessions.
v7-nav.verification: Rendered on Discover; tab order, badges and semantics unchanged.

critique.product: Baseline stays recommended because the four icons are conventional.
critique.visual: The floating pill is more distinctive.
critique.engineering: One flag on the shared bar; large text needs checking if chosen.

v7-filters.task: Say who I want to see and return.
v7-filters.problem: Tabs hide Advanced, and a choice there is invisible from Basic.
v7-filters.essential: Who, age, distance first; lifestyle later in the same list.
v7-filters.hypothesis: A single list reduces missed filters.

critique.product: Premium gating inside the list is unchanged.
critique.visual: Section headers carry the structure tabs did.

v7-paywall.task: Compare plans or understand what Premium adds.
v7-paywall.problem: Someone already decided must scroll past benefits.
v7-paywall.essential: Plans and prices; what you get.
v7-paywall.cost: Prices before value for someone who arrived from a locked feature.
v7-paywall.hypothesis: No change in amounts or terms; order only.
v7-paywall.verification: Rendered; plan amounts and disclosure text unchanged.

critique.product: Baseline recommended: value before price, no pressure.

tradeoffs.A: Asks for a decision before explaining.
